title: Building Automation Service Plans — Schedule of Covered Panels, Points and Point Licensing
content:
# Building Automation Service Plans — Schedule of Covered Panels, Points and Point Licensing

This schedule sets out, for every tier of the Building Automation Service Plans, the largest number of controls panels and monitored points the plan covers at one site, the fees that attach to points beyond or added to the covered count, and the software licence carried per covered point.

## Schedule

| Tier | Panels covered (max) | Points covered (max) | Point overage fee (USD per point per year) | Point addition fee (USD per point, one time) | Licence fee per covered point (USD per point per year) | Licence true-up |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | 2 | 150 | 9 | 45 | 0 | annual |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | 4 | 400 | 8 | 45 | 3 | annual |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | 8 | 900 | 7 | 40 | 4 | annual |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | 12 | 1500 | 6 | 40 | 6 | semiannual |
| Remote Optimization Plan | 20 | 3000 | 5 | 35 | 7 | quarterly |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | 60 | 12000 | 4 | 30 | 8 | monthly |

## Reading the columns

1. **Panels covered** is the largest number of controls panels the plan covers at one site; **points covered** is the largest number of monitored points the plan covers.
2. **Point overage fee** is the annual fee for each monitored point beyond the covered points. **Point addition fee** is the one-time fee for adding a point to the covered database.
3. **Licence fee per covered point** is the annual software licence fee for each covered point. The **licence true-up** column states how often the point count is trued up against the licence: once a year at the three lower tiers, twice a year under the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan, every quarter under the Remote Optimization Plan and every month under the Integrated Building Automation Partnership.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A site quoted under the Alarm Monitoring Plan with 400 covered points carries a licence fee of 400 multiplied by 3 USD, that is 1200 USD a year. The same count under the Controls Help Desk Subscription is not possible within the covered maximum of 150 points, and that tier carries no licence fee per point in any case.
